serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m something I like to call a professional internet gambler. 
Big Daddy: Oh, I never heard of it. I never even heard of a normal professional gambler, let alone an internet one.
Big Daddy: How does it work?
You: Well, there are websites with online roulette and blackjack. Thanks to mathematical formulas and my innate abilities I can turn profit just by playing.
Big Daddy: That’s…{{wi}} incredible. 
Big Daddy: But be careful. I have a hard time trusting all these internet people promising quick money.
I think I left a good impression on him!
